description: Adds analogue-style defects to a polyphonic cable: noise, crosstalk between channels, crackle, pitch wobble, bit crushing and dropouts.

params.text: Adds a low level of white noise, at a different level on each channel.
Mixes a small amount of each channel of the polyphonic cable into its neighbours.
Adds occasional bit-depth and sample-rate reduction.
Adds occasional dropouts, which silence samples.

inputs.text: The polyphonic audio the defects are applied to.

outputs.text: The input with the switched-on defects applied, carrying the same number of channels.

notes: every instance generates its own defects, so two of these modules do not sound alike.
